lines.en: : Okay, so, good news and bad news. The good news is that Niki is coming here to try and fix your sister.
: What’s the bad news?
: That at 8:46 AM EDT on September 11, 2001, American Airlines Flight 11 struck World Trade Center Tower 1 during one of the worst terrorist attacks in modern history.
: You’re right. That is bad news.
: But seeing as there’s nothing we can do about that now, we should probably focus on the task at hand.
: At least the second tower is still there.
: Chinami, I have more bad news.
: Oh no.

: On a serious note, though, which isn’t meant to imply that what we were just discussing isn’t serious, there’s a chance that this could backfire. And if that happens, I need you to promise me one thing.
: Of course. Chinami will do anything to help her Papa.
: I need you to destroy my laptop.
: Why?
: Don’t ask questions. Just follow orders. That is your job as my surrogate daughter.
: Chinami agrees. But only because it’s very rare for Papa to acknowledge that Chinami is his surrogate daughter.
: But wait, what do you mean by “backfire?” Is Niki actually a bad person who might murder big sis Chika for also being in love with you?
: No. But your sister is actually a bad person who might murder Niki for also being in love with me.
: Big sis Chika wouldn’t kill anybody! Chinami knows that for sure because it would have happened already!
: Either way, we need to be prepared for the worst. So be ready to call Tsukasa if anything happens because I have no idea how to dispose of a body and she probably does.
: Chinami thinks this would be so much easier if she could find an opportunity to take the knife away.
: It looks to me like you have a pretty good opportunity right now, not gonna lie.
: But she looks so content. Maybe the knife gives her comfort? And who is Chinami to take that away from her in her time of need?
: Sometimes, I think you only exist to sow further chaos and assist in the downfall of me as a person.
: Chinami will not confirm or deny this allegation. She’ll just close her eyes and wait until the celebrity gets here.
: You don’t want to change your outfit anymore?
: No. Chinami realized that Niki’s standards probably aren’t as high as Chinami expected since she apparently settled for you.
: I suddenly hope that the body I wind up having to dispose of is yours.
: Be careful what you wish for, Papa. For one day, that will likely be true.

After spending the next thirty minutes or so trying to snatch the knife out of Chika’s hands, I come to the realization that her apparent cat-like reflexes extend beyond awareness itself, making her much more intimidating out of nowhere.
This is a wonderful thing to discover just moments before introducing her to a girl she idolizes that also happens to have fellated me on a daily basis for an extended period of time.
Oh, look. There’s the blowjob now.
I mean girl.
: Less than twenty-four hours back together and you’re already abusing my status as the greatest woman to ever live. I truly despise you, Akira.
: You can despise me all you want later. Right now, what’s most important is harnessing the cuteness within you that you conceal from me daily and then dumping it all over a teenage girl.
: Mhm. And what do I get out of this exactly?
: You said it over the phone, didn’t you? Something about putting her in her place and dissuading her from further pursuing me.

: I’ve since reevaluated my stance in realizing that no one in their right mind would ever pursue you and so attempting to dissuade her from whatever mental illness compels her to in the first place would simply not work.
: You’re probably right about that. I’m not sure what else I can give you, though.
: I want my name carved beneath your eyelids so that every time you blink, you’ll be reminded of me.
: Who says I’m not already?
: Me after watching you rail my sister so hard that-
: Child!
: She’s pregnant?...
: Have you heard about what happened on September 11th?
: Akira, what are you teaching this girl? And also, why are you teaching this girl? Is high school no longer disgusting enough for you, so you must now corrupt even younger girls instead?
: Papa hasn’t corrupted me at all! He’s always very nice to Chinami.
: Papa?
: I knew I should have warned her not to call me that.
: Chinami calls Papa “Papa” because her real dad ran away and now he’s the only male figure in her life. You really think she’d choose this guy if she had other options?
: Wow, okay.
: I like her already. Your name’s Chinami?
: Mhm! Chinami Chosokabe! My sister’s your biggest fan ever, but I like you too!
: We listen to your music all the time. We used to have a bunch of posters too, but then we stopped being super poor and moved here and now we don’t have as many. Will you fix her, please?
: That’s her over there I’m guessing? With the knife in her hand that my childhood friend was supposed to remove but didn’t because he’s literally incapable of ever doing anything helpful or good?
: Yup! That’s her. You’re safe, though. Big sis Chika would never do anything to harm her idol. Or anybody really. Unless they’re a Yakuza guy named Gary. She hates Yakuza guys named Gary.
: How specific. Let’s see if I can wake her up. You be a good girl and wait here, okay? I don’t want you nearby if she gets excited and starts waving kitchen utensils around.
: Okay! Thank you, big sis Niki! Welcome to the family! Please be nice to my first sister since you’re sister number three and she has seniority!
: Niki’s super nice, Papa! I can’t believe you’ve been keeping her to yourself this entire time!
: It’s not like I wanted to. Your sister just worships her as some sort of god rather than a pop star.
: That’s because I am a god to a lot of these girls, Akira.
: The impact an idol can have on a person isn’t something normies could ever understand. Is it, Chika?
: Is it true you’re my biggest fan? Do you have a favorite song? A favorite album, perhaps?
: You know, come to think of it, I’m pretty sure my sister’s told me about you before. You two are in the light music club together, right? I hope she’s not annoying you too much.

: She can be a bit of a handful. Nothing like your little sister over there, who seems like nothing short of an angel. And I’m sure you’re a great influence on her, so a lot of that is probably thanks to you.
: Chinami is going to take this now.
: Thank you, Chinami. And no thank you to Akira, who wasn’t even useful enough to prevent you from approaching the kitchen utensils I warned you about.
: Chinami does what she wants and I have no authority over her. Trust me, I’ve tried.
: So, have you ever thought about becoming an idol yourself? Because you certainly have the look for it. You’re way cuter than I was at your age.
: Perhaps you’d like to try on one of my stage outfits? I can bring one over sometime if you’re interested. And hey, maybe I could even give you your own private show afterwards? How does that sound?
: Wow. If that’s not working, she might actually just be broken for good.
: What’s Chinami supposed to do if big sis Chika is broken for good?! She can’t stay like this! Chinami misses her already!
: Are you upset by what you saw on Instagram, maybe? Because you’re not alone if that’s the case.
: But here’s the thing, Chika. It’s not personal at all. And I don’t want you or any of my fans to see this is some sort of betrayal. Or even a permanent goodbye.
: I just need to do what makes me happy if I’m going to keep being my best self. And I can promise you that I will never stop loving and believing in you. Okay?
: Yeah, Akira’s right. I think she’s just flat out broken.
: Great. Now Chinami has no blood-related family left. Could today get any worse?
: Maybe try touching her? Like...give her a hug or something?
: Who am I, you? I’m not going to touch some teenage girl without her consent. I don’t even do handshake events anymore.
: I mean, you probably don’t do anything anymore after the stunt you pulled yesterday.
: You’re completely right. In fact, I’m supposed to be at the office getting yelled at right now. I just figured it wouldn’t hurt to do this first since my career is already in shambles.
: Chinami gives you consent to hug her sister if that helps...
: It doesn’t. But that’s a very kind gesture, Chinami. I’m sorry I couldn’t help more. But if your sister ever wakes up, maybe the three of us can do something fun together?
: I imagine I’ll have plenty of free time from now on, so just ask Akira over here to let me know. Okay?
: Okay, but...does this mean you’re not going to make music anymore? Because both Chinami and big sis Chika will be really sad if that’s true.
: I’ll keep making music since that’s how I express myself. It just might sound a little different than what you guys are used to.
: Any last requests from me before I get out of here?
: Just one. If you start making new kinds of music, can you promise Chinami that it won’t sound like Sleep Token? Because she really just doesn’t get what anybody sees in them.
: Can we trade Ami for this one? She’s so much better.
: Most of them are, Niki. But Ami is the one I deserve.
: That said, I should probably get going too. I’m trying to earn more points with the reinforcement I called in today and I feel like points are being actively subtracted every second I spend here.
: You would be correct in thinking that, yes.
: Fine...Chinami will try figuring out new ways to fix big sis Chika on her own. It’s safer now that she doesn’t have the knife anymore.
: Call me if you need me, okay? But literally only if you need me because, again, trying to earn idol points.
: You’re going to need a lot of them if you don’t want to be put on a leash.
: See what I mean? Chika’s not the only one in danger here.
: Chinami understands...But thank you anyway.
: It was nice meeting you, Niki. You look even prettier in person. I’m sure big sis Chika would say the same thing if her brain still worked.
: I’m sure she would too because I am prettier in person.
: Now — come, Akira. If I’m going to sit around and get yelled at for the next few hours, I’m dragging you along with me on the off chance it makes my producers less abrasive.
: What? You mean I have to get yelled at too?
: Or you could try being a man for once and defending my honor. Up to you.
: Ugh...I’ll just get yelled at too. That’s easier...
: Hah...And just like that, Chinami is an only child.
: But how’s she supposed to live on her own when she can’t even reach the freezer without a step stool?
: At least she can probably get Tsukasa to pay her bills. She’s even more desperate for companionship than Chinami is.
: AHHHHH!
: Ahhhhh!
: AHHHHHHHHHHHHH!
: Ahhhhhh?!?!?!?
: AHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!!!!!!!!!!!!
: How long are we going to do this for?!?!?!
: DID YOU SEE THAT?!?!?! NIKI WAS INSIDE OUR HOME! SHE CALLED ME CUTE! OUR FACES WERE LIKE THIS CLOSE! SHE SMELLED SO GOOD!
: Ch...Chinami doesn’t remember how she smelled! But she’s glad big sis Chika is suddenly alive again!
: ALIVE? I’VE NEVER FELT THIS ALIVE IN MY LIFE! I COULD BE HIT BY A PLANE RIGHT NOW AND BE TOTALLY FINE!
: Chinami doesn’t understand one of the recurring themes in this event and wants to know when it will stop!
: WE’VE BEEN BLESSED! THIS HOUSE HAS FELT THE TOUCH OF A GOD! NOTHING BAD WILL EVER HAPPEN TO US AGAIN! I DON’T EVEN CARE THAT SHE’S STEALING MY MAN! I DESERVE IT! I CAN NOT COMPARE!
: Ch...Chinami doesn’t want big sis Chika talking that way about herself! Big sis Chika is pretty and amazing too! And Chinami think she’s just too excited to realize how sad she is right now...
: THE QUEEN TOLD ME I WAS CUTE! I HAVE NO REASON TO EVER FEEL SADNESS AGAIN! I WISH SHE WAS STILL HERE SO I COULD CONSENT TO EVERYTHING.
: You’re...you’re kind of...scaring Chinami right now...
: Put your helmet on. We’re going to the mall.
: N...Now? But big sis Chika hasn’t eaten or taken a bath in almost twenty-four hours...And Chinami is hungry too. So-

: We can eat later! There are more pressing matters we must attend to! I have to buy every single thing Niki has ever been involved in! My love has multiplied tenfold! I MUST HAVE IT ALL! NO ONE BUT ME!
: D...Do we even have the money for that?...
: I’ll steal it if I have to! Get me a helmet too! To hide my identity! And where did you put my knife?! We might need it!
: But Chinami literally just told everybody you weren’t a murderer!!!
: THAT WAS OLD CHIKA! I HAVE BEEN REBORN! THE WORLD WILL KNOW MY LOVE! NIKI WILL KNOW MY LOVE! EVEN IF EVERYONE ELSE ABANDONS HER!
: CHINAMI IS STARTING TO THINK YOU WERE BETTER OFF AS A STATUE!!!
Chinami’s affection has increased to [chinami_love]!
Niki’s affection has increased to [niki_love]!
Chika’s affection has overloaded and is not currently functioning...
